description:
Reentrancy in ManagerVault._swap(address,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes) (src/ManagerVault.sol#306-339):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- IDexAdapter(adapter).swapExactIn(tokenIn,tokenOut,amountIn,minAmountOut,address(this),deadline,data) (src/ManagerVault.sol#329-330)
	Balance read before the call:
	- outBefore = IERC20(tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/ManagerVault.sol#315-318)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- received < minAmountOut (src/ManagerVault.sol#334-336)
		- stale variable `received`
markdown:
Reentrancy in [ManagerVault._swap(address,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes)](src/ManagerVault.sol#L306-L339):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- [IDexAdapter(adapter).swapExactIn(tokenIn,tokenOut,amountIn,minAmountOut,address(this),deadline,data)](src/ManagerVault.sol#L329-L330)
	Balance read before the call:
	- [outBefore = IERC20(tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this))](src/ManagerVault.sol#L315-L318)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- [received < minAmountOut](src/ManagerVault.sol#L334-L336)
		- stale variable `received`
